overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: two members' posts on a public message board were not directed to a quorum, so no deliberation occurred, though the AG cautioned that quorum-level board discussions would be improper.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Chair and a member discussed School Committee matters through a public website message board, deliberating outside an open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that, because the communications were not directed to a quorum of the members of the Committee, and because a quorum of the members did not participate in posting to the website, that the Committee did not deliberate outside of an open meeting and did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

source.publisher_filename: DETERMINATION - 6 4 2013 - OML 2013-74 - GILL-MONTAGUE REGIONAL SCHOOL COMMITTEE.pdf
